flips.note: audit: flip_sensitive changes the audit record only; deep: the attribute in every layer that holds it, nothing recomputed; financial: region moved with its housing cost (rent multiplier), so DTI follows. Compared: credit decision and reason codes, underwriting decision and codes, every fraud rule, and the credit model's 14 features (identical features give an identical PD and identical reasons).

fairness.four_fifths_note: groups below 0.8 of the highest group's rate are listed as a monitoring reference only, not a legal test
fairness.interval_methods: approval rate: Wilson 95%; adverse impact ratio: Katz log-scale 95%

as_is_policy_reference.label: as-is policy (claimed FICO): sees the true score; not a fair benchmark

bureau_score_policy.label: bureau-score policy (the champion): the credit policy's thresholds on the bureau FICO

credit_pd_xgb_cutoff.label: credit_pd_xgb: the lowest-PD applications up to the champion's approval count

proxy.method: depth-2 XGBoost (100 trees) predicting the attribute from the 14 features; 5-fold cross-validated AUC, one-vs-rest macro-averaged for more than two groups; percentile interval from 200 bootstrap resamples; top three features by gain named above 0.6

label: Developer testing on synthetic data; the credit policy makes the decision.
